name: clamdscan
description: ClamAV - clamdscan is a one-shot filesystem malware scanner for Unraid using ClamAV and clamdscan. When the container starts, it updates the ClamAV virus signatures, starts clamd, scans the configured folder or folders, writes persistent scan logs, and then exits when the scan is complete. The folder mounted at /scan is read-only by default. View the Docker log for live scan activity and the persistent ClamAV log folder for saved scan results and previous-run history. Project: https://github.com/bmartino1/clamav-alpine

paths.name: Folder to Scan
paths.description: Host folder to scan. This folder is mounted read-only inside the container at /scan.

paths.name: ClamAV Signature Database
paths.description: Persistent storage for ClamAV virus signature databases downloaded by freshclam.

paths.name: ClamAV Configuration
paths.description: Persistent editable ClamAV configuration. On first run, missing clamd.conf and freshclam.conf are copied from the maintainer defaults stored inside the image. Existing configuration files are preserved on later runs so custom settings such as ExcludePath remain intact.

paths.name: ClamAV Log Storage
paths.description: Persistent storage for clamd.log, clamdscan results, detected-file summaries, and previous scan history.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: ID of the user the application runs as root.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: ID of the group the application runs as root.

variables.name: Scan Folders
variables.description: Container path or paths to scan. Default is /scan. Multiple mounted container paths may be separated by spaces, for example: /scan /scan2

variables.name: Exclude Paths
variables.description: Container path or paths to exclude from scanning. Multiple paths may be separated by spaces. Default excludes this container's own persistent appdata when /mnt/user is mounted at /scan.

variables.name: Log History Limit
variables.description: Number of previous scan log archives to keep. Default is 3. Set to 0 to disable archived scan history and remove managed history archives.
